mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.0% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by at least 1.0% from their prior 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-crisis recovery regime, a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflation concerns that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-crisis recovery regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS declines by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1400.0 thousand units signals a collapse in the housing sector, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls below 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 declines by at least 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.3% from the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown regime, a further decline in industrial production (INDPRO) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the manufacturing slowdown regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% from the prior month.
